properties.name: Florida
properties.what: SB 1084, signed May 2024. Unlawful to manufacture for sale, sell, hold or offer for sale, or distribute cultivated meat. First US state to act. A federal appeals court upheld it in March 2026.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Alabama
properties.what: Enacted 2024. Prohibits manufacture and sale of cell-cultured meat products, with a carve-out in the statute.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Mississippi
properties.what: HB 1006, March 2025. Bans manufacturing, selling or distributing cultivated food products derived from animal cells. Passed unanimously.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Montana
properties.what: Enacted 2025. Bans sale and manufacture of cell-cultured meat.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Nebraska
properties.what: LB 246, 2025. First Midwestern state to prohibit sale or manufacture, paired with an executive order barring state agencies from buying it.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: South Dakota
properties.what: SB 124, 2026. A five-year prohibition on sale, manufacture and distribution, following 2025 measures on labelling and state research funding.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Indiana
properties.what: A two-year moratorium running to 30 June 2027, after which cultivated products sold in the state must be labelled an imitation meat product.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Texas
properties.what: Enacted 2025, seventh state to ban. Sunsets 1 September 2027 unless extended. Under legal challenge.
properties.source: the abattoir atlas list (National Agricultural Law Center, Alternative Protein Laws State Compilation, updated 7 April 2026; Food Safety Magazine, 'Texas Becomes Seventh State to Ban Cultivated Meat', June 2025; US News, 'States Try to Snuff Out Lab-Grown Meat Before It Really Starts', December 2025)

properties.name: Illinois
properties.what: HB 0015, the Illinois Cultivated Meat Act, would prohibit the manufacture, sale and distribution of cultivated meat. Introduced; not passed as far as found.
properties.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

properties.name: Michigan
properties.what: HB 4083 would prohibit the sale of cultivated meat. Introduced 12 February 2025; carried over into 2026.
properties.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

properties.name: North Dakota
properties.what: A 2025 bill (HB 1151) to prohibit in-state production and sale of cultivated meat. Not among the states with a ban as of 2026.
properties.source: CSG Midwest, 4 May 2026; Brooks Institute Animal Law Digest, issue 276

properties.name: Ohio
properties.what: A 2025 bill to prohibit in-state production and sale of cultivated meat. Not among the states with a ban as of 2026.
properties.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

properties.name: Wisconsin
properties.what: AB 554 would have restricted sales of lab-grown meat unless labelled and barred schools and other state institutions from serving it. Vetoed by Governor Tony Evers.
properties.source: CSG Midwest, 'Cell-cultured meat remains focus of new laws and legislation across the Midwest', updated 4 May 2026

properties.name: Arizona
properties.what: HB 2791 (2026) would make selling cell-cultured protein for human consumption a crime (up to 18 months in prison); HB 2672 would require a label. Introduced; outcome not found.
properties.source: Arizona Capitol Times, 'Arizona may become first state to ban lab-grown meat', 20 January 2026

properties.name: West Virginia
properties.what: HB 4462 (2026) would ban the manufacture and sale of cell-cultured food products; passed the House Government Organization Committee on 9 February 2026. Outcome not found.
properties.source: West Virginia Watch (States Newsroom), 'Effort to ban lab-grown meat ... underway in WV House', 10 February 2026

properties.name: Tennessee
properties.what: A proposed ban was shelved in 2024 after lawmakers argued it would restrict consumers' choices.
properties.source: Stateline, 'Lab-grown meat isn't on store shelves yet, but some states have already banned it', 2024 (Brookings Register)

properties.name: Iowa
properties.what: A 2024 law bars schools from buying lab-grown meat.
properties.source: Stateline, 'Lab-grown meat isn't on store shelves yet, but some states have already banned it', 2024 (Brookings Register)
